text:
maya (AE): Heads up — Biometrix (POC) pushed back. Procurement wants net45, they want an explicit biometric-data clause in the DPA, and a lower SLA for uptime (they want 99.5 -> 99.0). Also asking for EU data residency and HSM/KMS requirement. Can we escalate?
liam (SalesOps): thanks — can you drop the PO + customer contact? I can try to fast-track billing but legal needs to weigh the biometric ask.
maya (AE): PO attached in thread (invoice_4592.pdf) and contact is sara@biometrix.ai. They said POC must include biometric matching sample traffic.
jordan (Legal): tagging — @maya we need the exact clause they want. Biometric language is high risk. We shouldn't accept unconstrained biometric processing in hosted without strong safeguards. Can procurement share proposed text?
maya (AE): they pasted this in email: "Customer may submit biometric identifiers and the Provider shall process for the purposes of identity verification."
jordan (Legal): okay that's too broad. We can propose a limited processing addendum: purpose-limited, data minimization, retention cap (30 days), mandatory encryption-at-rest with HSM, and explicit consent/PIA. Also insist on logging, access controls, and right to audit.
priya (Security): +1 from security. Need SOC2 cert + privacy impact assessment. If they insist on biometric matching, we need us to run the matching on a private VPC deployment or Dedicated capacity — cannot do it on multi-tenant hosted unless data is pseudonymized and strongly isolated.
alex (CS): Customer asked if we can accept net45 for PO today so they can start hardware tests. If legal needs Dedicated, they'll need pricing delta.
liam (SalesOps): can we propose a two-step orderform: initial POC on Dedicated trial (30d) with standard MSA+DPA + biometric addendum limited to test data set; payment on net30 for the trial; full production order afterwards with net45?
jordan (Legal): that seems reasonable. I'll draft a biometric addendum and a short change to the DPA restricting processing, retention, and requiring HSM/KMS with CMEK. Also add: "Provider will not use biometric data for model training or improvements."
priya (Security): require encryption keys customer-managed (CMEK) for biometric PII. Also require on-premises or VPC Dedicated option for production.
maya (AE): can you draft the orderform redline + addendum? Need it to hand to procurement today. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
jordan (Legal): I can do a version in the next 3 hours. Quick Q: do we have pricing for a 30d Dedicated trial with HSM? @liam
liam (SalesOps): estimate +30% on top of hosted list for Dedicated with reserved HSM. I'll attach a ballpark (price_ballpark.xlsx).
maya (AE): procurement asked about liability cap for biometric incidents — they want higher cap.
jordan (Legal): we can offer a limited exception: increase cap for biometric processing only to $X (product will confirm). Need exec signoff for that.
legal-bot: Reminder: please add "legal-review" tag to thread and set priority: high.
alex (CS): I'll coordinate with infra to confirm Dedicated throughput and HSM availability for POC.
priya (Security): also request that Biometrix completes our Security Questionnaire and provides recent pen test report.
maya (AE): I'll ping them now and attach the questionnaire. Back to you all with their proposed clause once they reply. :thumbsup:
jordan (Legal): Thanks. I'll prepare two redline options: (A) Hosted with heavy restrictions + pseudonymization, (B) Dedicated + HSM with addendum. We can present both to procurement.
liam (SalesOps): sounds good. If procurement accepts option B we can sign the orderform asap and set billing terms to net30 for trial.
maya (AE): filing action items: 1) @jordan draft addendum, 2) @liam price + orderform draft, 3) @priya list security prerequisites, 4) @alex confirm infra availability.
alex (CS): on it.
maya (AE): thanks everyone — will follow up once Biometrix replies with clause.
